Using the number tiles, Joan and Herbert played a new game.
They placed the numbers to make the largest answer.

C. Use the tiles [1], [4], and [5]. Write the numbers on the tiles in the boxes below to make the largest answer when you multiply.

[Image: Vertical multiplication layout with boxes]

descriptors: Any other arrangement of the digits 1, 4, and 5
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A vertical multiplication problem setup with two rows above a horizontal line. The top row has two square boxes side by side. The bottom row has a multiplication sign (×) on the left and a single square box aligned under the right box of the top row.
